spots.name: Chehalem Valley Brewing
spots.description: Established in 2011, Chehalem Valley Brewery had a vision to satisfy a variety of beer connoisseurs with their local ingredients and long time beer knowledge. Starting with a history of home brewing, and an excitement for sharing new creations, CVB opened their doors in Newberg, Oregon where they have established a family-friendly traditional style brewery and restaurant where the local community can gather.
